name: typing_modernize
description: Old typing spellings (List, Dict, Tuple, Optional, Union). Hidden tests check the real type hints, so only a true migration passes.

hidden_tests.tests/test_hints.py:
import typing

from inventory.models import bounds, find_item, parse_qty, stock_by_location


def test_hints_are_builtin_generics():
    assert typing.get_type_hints(bounds)["values"] == list[int]
    assert typing.get_type_hints(bounds)["return"] == tuple[int, int]
    assert typing.get_type_hints(stock_by_location)["return"] == dict[str, int]
    assert typing.get_type_hints(find_item)["return"] == (dict | None)
    assert typing.get_type_hints(parse_qty)["raw"] == (str | int)
